card.name: Endings -ist, -ism, -less on nouns
card.fires_on: The ending piece (-ist, -ists, -ism, -less) attached to a noun stem such as czar, Royal, druid, Grace or claw. Mostly in history and general web text, occasionally inside a drug name.

modes.label: -ist / -ism endings
modes.description: A political or belief word is completed by -ist, -ists or -ism after a stem like Royal, czar or druid.
